claims.claim_text: William A Coates has a confirmed match to the exact name and private identifier in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed identifier selects one of four exact-name Army rows and dates Army entry to 8 March 1945 as a private.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier and exact indexed name establish the identity match; the other same-name Army rows carry different identifiers and are not merged.
claims.temporal_assessment: The record dates Army entry but does not date OSS service or prove when the recorded occupation was held.
claims.match_notes: The matched private grade supports enlisted Army classification. The identifier remains private, and unfamiliar branch coding is not expanded or guessed.

claims.claim_text: An official Army-entry record assigns William A Coates the broad category Teachers (secondary school) and principals; no school or employer is identified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-matched Army row carries occupation value 031, decoded on the visually inspected official NARA code page.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier and exact indexed name select the correct row among four same-name Army records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The category was captured at Army entry on 8 March 1945; actual work dates and relationship to OSS service are unknown.
claims.match_notes: Occupation remains distinct from employer. No school, district, precise role, immediate predecessor or last civilian employer is inferred.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The indexed private identifier produced no literal or zero-prefixed Army-file match, the complete Army file contains no exact-name Philip B Coan row, and reviewed public sources do not supply an OSS or Box 130 bridge. person_updates.next_action: Review Box 130 for Philip B Coan's full identity, personnel status, occupation, employer and OSS assignment and determine what service system issued the printed identifier.

research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The older New York journalist and editor Philip Coan is identified in institutional records as Philip Munson Coan, conflicting with indexed middle initial B; modern namesakes are chronologically incompatible; none carries the private identifier, OSS context or Box 130 bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: The printed identifier is not altered to force an Army match. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
research_attempts.next_action: Establish full identity and the identifier's issuing service from Box 130.
